# Security

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately to **support@underdoginnovationinc.com** with “Focus security report” in the subject. Include the affected commit, a description, and safe reproduction steps.

Do not include real API keys, private screenshots, or session databases. Do not post sensitive details in a public issue.

Focus currently has no versioned binary releases. Please reproduce issues against the latest `main` when practical. There is no guaranteed response time; this is a small open-source project.

For how Focus handles screenshots, credentials, and provider requests, see the [privacy guide](../docs/privacy.md).
